crossRefs.note: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
crossRefs.keyword: for our help. Heb. a help for us. redeem

crossRefs.note: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
crossRefs.keyword: for our help. Heb. a help for us. redeem

crossRefs.note: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.
crossRefs.keyword: for our help. Heb. a help for us. redeem

translations.web: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.
translations.bsb: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
translations.kjv: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies'
translations.asv: Rise up for our help, And redeem us for thy lovingkindness' sake. Psalm 45 For the Chief Musician; set to Shoshannim. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Maschil. A Song of loves.
